name: 49417 · Grand Haven, MI
findings: ZIP 49417 (Grand Haven) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 71 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 61 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49417 (Grand Haven) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49417 (Grand Haven) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
